payload.rationale: Direct domain-gap and CAD-program-synthesis bridge: addresses synthetic-to-real transfer for models predicting parametric CAD command sequences, closely analogous to our synthetic-inverse-factory-to-real-CAD transfer problem.
Lightweight hidden-state verifier for LLM math reasoning; the frozen/deterministic nature of our geometric verifier limits transfer, only a loose methodological echo of verifier-in-the-loop training.
Dual-arm RGB-D dataset for robotic perception; no bridge to program synthesis, pointer/graph transformers, or mesh generation.
Real-to-sim scene asset parsing/placement pipeline for embodied AI; unrelated application with no transferable mechanism to our care areas.

Render-aware, execution-feedback-guided sampling for autoregressive structured (SVG) generation to maintain global geometric consistency -- a close methodological analog to execution/verifier-guided decoding for structural validity.
Off-the-shelf constrained decoding applied to auction-catalog extraction; no new mechanism transferable to our structured generation problem.
"Rotation-invariant" here refers to eigenbasis/permutation invariance of a financial correlation matrix, not pose/rotation robustness of geometric encoders; domain and mechanism do not transfer.
Comprehensive tutorial/survey on rotational equivariance, useful background but not a new mechanism, and our own equivariance line is explicitly closed per the problem statement.
GNN+LLM collaboration for molecular property prediction; unrelated application domain with only generic GAT usage, no transferable structural-validity or pointer mechanism.
Native audio-video generation system; no bridge to program synthesis, CAD, or graph/pointer mechanisms.
RL fine-tuning of dual-encoder retrievers for e-commerce search; embedding-geometry preservation trick is domain-specific and not transferable to program generation.
Survey of tensor-decomposition methods for LLM efficiency/compression/interpretability; no bridge to our care areas.
Hidden-state-based runtime safety/hallucination guardrail for LLM deployment; conceptually adjacent to verifier-in-the-loop but targets safety monitoring, not structural/geometric program validity.
ECG waveform tokenization for diagnostic classification; unrelated application, no transferable mechanism.

Probes whether autoregressive text/code models internally track 2D spatial layout while generating structured (code/SVG) output -- a relevant analog to whether our decoder tracks partial construction state, but it is a diagnostic benchmark on generic LLMs rather than a technique we could adopt.
Goal-conditioned actor-critic RL with subgoal shaping; unrelated to program synthesis or CAD/mesh generation.

Finds Transformers' append-only KV cache fails to track hidden world state over long rollouts, while some recurrent/linear-attention variants succeed -- a plausible but indirect concern for long autoregressive program rollouts that must track partial mesh-construction state.

Personalized generative retrieval via semantic IDs for e-commerce; structured-ID generation and decoding-latency concerns are surface-similar but the mechanism (retrieval personalization) doesn't transfer.

Localized re-masking/infilling for targeted code repair plus an iterative RL debugging scheme with intermediate rewards is a direct methodological match to repair/edit-distillation for fixing broken program rollouts (care area 1).
Pure combinatorial geometry proof about universal covers; no ML content or bridge to our problem.
Cross-lingual reasoning transfer via sparse autoencoder feature steering in LLMs; unrelated to geometric program generation.
Interpretable additive GNN for molecular ADME prediction; generic GNN but no transferable structural-validity, pointer, or verifier mechanism.

Position/survey paper on scaling RLVR and self-generated curricula toward less human supervision; conceptually adjacent to our verifier-in-the-loop self-improvement flywheel (reward hacking risk especially) but is a broad survey, not an adoptable method, on math/code/agentic tasks.
Tabular foundation model adapted for physiological time series classification; unrelated domain.
Mask-free video virtual try-on with optical-flow supervision; unrelated to our problem.

Theoretical characterization proving any fixed equivariant multi-head-attention architecture loses expressivity relative to the full equivariant function class -- directly bears on rotation/pose-robust set/graph encoders and symmetry-orbit ambiguity in pointer attention, though it is pure theory with no released code.

Graph attention network verifying correctness of LLM reasoning chains represented as graphs -- a moderate methodological echo of graph-transformer-based verification, but applied to natural-language reasoning chains rather than programs/geometry.
GNN-based beamforming for mmWave massive MIMO wireless systems; generic message passing but no transferable mechanism to program synthesis or B-rep encoding.
Multi-view human pose triangulation from heatmaps; unrelated to our problem.
Real-time video anomaly detection via pose estimation and CLIP scoring; unrelated to our problem.
Continuous-embedding-space autoregressive reasoning replacing discrete token generation; our decoder must emit discrete, executable DSL commands from a closed vocabulary, so this doesn't transfer.

Self-play-trained driving policies with documented reward-hacking failure modes (e.g., gaming traffic-light reward) -- a useful cautionary analog for verifier-in-the-loop reward hacking, but the domain (autonomous driving, MLP/Transformer policies) and mechanism don't directly transfer.
